messages:
elaine (AE): Hey team — Neptune Health confirmed they want to run a 3-week trial. Need to align scope, success criteria, and outstanding security/pricing asks. Can we sync today?

sam (SE): Available 1pm PST. main goals?

elaine (AE): Jordan said primary use case: clinician note summarization and triage suggestions from intake notes. Secondary: embeddings for search across patient docs.

oliver (SolutionsEng): For summarization we should capture: avg tokens/input, expected RPS at peak, and acceptable latency SLO (p50/p95). Do we have sample prompts/evals from them?

jordan (Prod Lead - Neptune Health): We can share a 100-item prompt set and ~200 anonymized notes for eval. Target latency: p95 < 600ms for short notes (~300 tokens). Peak is low initially (~5-10 RPS).

maria (CISO - Neptune Health): Quick note — will need answers to our security questionnaire (data residency, KMS, audit logs, SOC2 scope). Also we cannot allow persistent storage of PHI in hosted trials; bringing this up early.

liam (SalesOps): Pricing question from procurement: trial usage above free credits — what's the overage rate and is there a short-term dedicated capacity option?

sam (SE): For small RPS we've got hosted API that fits. Overage: standard hosted rate; I can confirm exact $/1k tokens in a follow-up. Dedicated short-term reserve possible but needs 2-week lead for GPU pool allocation.

oliver (SolutionsEng): On PHI: we can run trial on Redwood Private (customer VPC) or provide a scrubbed dataset on hosted. Which do they prefer?

maria (CISO - Neptune Health): Prefer customer VPC or on-prem. For the trial, scrubbed data is acceptable if we still get realistic evals. Need SOC2 audit docs and KMS integration details before kickoff.

elaine (AE): OK — action items: (1) Jordan to share prompt/eval set + sample notes (anonymized) by EOD today; (2) Sam to share hosted overage pricing and short-term Dedicated lead times; (3) Oliver to outline Private trial checklist (network, KMS, audit docs) and minimum infra estimate; (4) Liam to prepare trial-commit language for procurement. Can folks confirm?

sam (SE): Confirm — I'll post pricing snippet and a quick runbook for scrubbed-hosted vs private tradeoffs.

oliver (SolutionsEng): Confirm — I'll attach a 1-page Private trial checklist and config required (VPC peering, KMS ARNs, allowed egress).

liam (SalesOps): Confirm. Also propose a 3-week timeline: week 0 - ingest & baseline evals; week 1 - tuning + QA prompts; week 2 - final eval + handoff. Notes?

jordan (Prod Lead - Neptune Health): Timeline looks good. We'll aim to deliver data + SOW by EOD.

maria (CISO - Neptune Health): I'll loop in compliance team if you send SOC2 + KMS docs. Also need proof of no persistent PHI on hosted endpoints.

elaine (AE): Great. Last: success criteria suggested — (A) summarization ROUGE/QA pass rate threshold on their eval set, (B) embedding retrieval MRR improvement vs baseline, (C) p95 latency within target, (D) documented security checklist closed. Thoughts?

oliver (SolutionsEng): Add cost-per-inference estimate for their projected monthly volume as a soft KPI so procurement can evaluate.

liam (SalesOps): I'll include a templated cost projection sheet in the procurement packet.

deploy-bot: Reminder: please add meeting to calendar if scheduling now.

elaine (AE): Putting a 1pm PST quick sync on calendar now. If anyone needs earlier, ping me. Thanks all :thumbsup:
